current.description: A local Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets AI coding agents explore any C# project or solution, whether or not it uses Metalama Framework. The agent runs C# queries over the semantic model of the compiler to answer questions about types, members, inheritance and references. When a project uses Metalama, the queries also cover its aspects and the transformed code. The server requires the .NET 10 SDK or later. It speaks MCP only over stdio. Results in the html format are served to the user's browser on https://localhost, on a random port, behind a secret token; that server runs only the queries that the user edits in its pages. The server sends anonymous usage telemetry and lets the user review exception reports, according to the telemetry settings of Metalama.
